title: eschscholzia californica var. maritima
intro: Eschscholzia californica var. maritima, commonly known as the California poppy or coastal poppy, is a variant of the California poppy plant, characterized by its ability to thrive in coastal environments. This plant has been utilized for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Eschscholzia californica var. maritima include its sedative and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
